# WhatsApp Message Templates

### VIP Taxi Service KSA

These templates are used by the booking widget to pre-fill the WhatsApp message sent by customers. The vehicle class MUST appear in the message to prevent the wrong-vehicle issue noted in reviews.

---

## Template 1 — Transfer booking (auto-generated by QuoteWidget)

The widget builds this message automatically. It is URL-encoded and appended to `https://wa.me/966539720003?text=`.

```
*VIP Taxi Service KSA — Booking Request*

*Route:* [FROM] → [TO]
*Date:* [DATE]
*Time:* [TIME]
*Passengers:* [NUMBER]
*Luggage:* [X large bags, Y small bags]
*Vehicle class:* [VEHICLE CLASS NAME]
*Name:* [CUSTOMER NAME (optional)]

[src:TRACKING_SOURCE]
```

**Rules:**

- `[VEHICLE CLASS NAME]` must always be present and match exactly the class shown in the widget dropdown.
- `[src:TRACKING_SOURCE]` captures UTM/referrer (e.g. `src:google-organic`, `src:direct`, `src:facebook-ad`).
- If any field is empty, omit that line (not blank lines in the message).

---

## Template 2 — Post-trip review request (driver sends manually, 24h after drop-off)

```
Assalamu Alaikum [Customer Name],

Thank you for travelling with VIP Taxi KSA! We hope your journey was comfortable and on time.

If you have 2 minutes, a Google review would help other pilgrims find us:
[GBP REVIEW LINK]

JazakAllah Khair 🙏

— VIP Taxi Service KSA
+966 53 972 0003
```

**Notes:**

- Replace `[GBP REVIEW LINK]` with `site.gbpReviewUrl` once confirmed.
- Never offer discounts or gifts in exchange for reviews — this violates Google's policies.

---

## Template 3 — Confirmation message (driver sends after booking is confirmed)

```
Assalamu Alaikum [Customer Name],

Your transfer is confirmed. Here are your booking details:

*Route:* [FROM] → [TO]
*Date & Time:* [DATE] at [TIME]
*Vehicle:* [VEHICLE CLASS — e.g. Toyota Hiace 7-seater van]
*Driver:* [DRIVER NAME] will contact you 30 minutes before pickup.
*Pickup point:* [HOTEL NAME / AIRPORT TERMINAL]

Please ensure your luggage is ready at the lobby/arrivals hall at the agreed time.

Any changes? Reply to this message.

— VIP Taxi Service KSA
+966 53 972 0003
```

**Critical rule:** The `[VEHICLE CLASS]` line in the confirmation message must state the actual vehicle the driver will bring, not just "a vehicle". This is the business's formal commitment and prevents mismatches.
